always appreciated. rory gallagher square, paul street opening times monday to friday 8.30am to 4pm saturday 9.30am to 5.45pm sunday 10.30am to 4pm reflection gratitude opens the heart. here at emmaus café, giving thanks for small joys — friendship, warmth, and shared meals — helps us see god’s goodness everywhere, like the disciples on the road. “give thanks in all circumstances.” (1 thessalonians 5:18) prayers of the faithful 1. for the church: that she may be a faithful witness to god’s love through her words and actions, especially in the care for those most in need. lord, hear us. 2. for our meetings in families of parishes : that the holy spirit may guide our conversations and help us work together to strengthen parish life. lord, hear us. 3. for our parish community: that we may welcome strangers, care for those who have lost loved ones and stand up for those who are treated unfairly. lord, hear us. 4. for families: that, during this month of the rosary, families may find opportunities to pray together and grow in faith and love. lord, hear us. 5. for those travelling this bank holiday weekend: that they may have safe journeys and enjoy time with family and friends. lord, hear us. 6. for peace: that hatred and division may give way to understanding, forgiveness and a renewed respect for every human life. lord, hear us. office hours in the family of parishes
